study.question: Does the value of nonreadout compressed-history support gradients come mainly from Dice centering, variance scaling, or their interaction, and can selective moment-gradient routing improve validation click AUC over the incumbent at unchanged learned capacity?
study.hypothesis: Observed limitation: g0-r0022-support_rotated_attached click AUC 0.666753547526167 exceeds rotated_blocked 0.6661241491820656 by 0.0006293983441014; aligned attached versus blocked gives +0.0005677410648235. Rotated versus aligned attached differs by only +0.0000915106878374. These are single-seed population contrasts, not independent repetitions or established mechanisms. Rows not read out can influence selected scores through shared Dice moments and consequent training updates. Provisional mechanism: support contributions to the mean gradient supply most of the useful coupling, while variance-gradient coupling can be redundant or antagonistic. Enabling mean alone should retain most of the both-minus-neither click gain and may exceed both. The four-cell factorial can instead support variance dominance or interaction. Positive click outcomes do not establish improved performance on every task.

nearest_work.difference: Archived exact-version primary DIN text section 5.2, lines317-335, defines batch mean/variance Dice gates and moving evaluation moments. We inherit this activation and local scorer; this study changes only which support rows differentiate through which moment. No invention of Dice, batch normalization or stop-gradient, or originality/priority claim.

inherited_components: All architecture and initialization from g0-r0022-support_rotated_attached: field embeddings; 70 primary and 30 auxiliary slots; counts, masks, action-aware unnormalized DIN scorer; uniform click readout; feedback-stratified auxiliary readout.
Five existing target-match/ordinal/quadratic/gated-duplicate residual summaries, log counts and task-specific zero-initialized adapters; four Dice towers.
Primary-owned item/action/scorer parameters and shared context ownership; auxiliary parameter stop-gradients and cloned nonpersistent scorer buffers.
Unchanged frozen host training recipe, four BCEs, split, seed and validation scoring.
study.proposed_difference: Two boolean architecture controls support_mean_gradient and support_variance_gradient act only in primary scorer Dice training. First three strata keep all paths. Last four strata keep or lose each moment derivative independently. Both=True uses exact inherited native attached operator; both=False uses exact inherited detach-before-each-Dice operator. Mixed cells call native BN once, compute constant FP32 mean/inverse standard deviation, then add zero-valued links with support-only gradients that cancel the unwanted native mean or variance derivative. Direct rowwise derivatives remain, allowing gradients from retained moments at later layers. This changes the backward operator, not available information, forward normalization population, state update rule, learned capacity or evaluation graph. No new buffers or trainable parameters. Prospective study recorded before host experiments.
predictions: Predeclared directional prediction: mean-only minus neither retains at least half the both-minus-neither click AUC gain within this paired four-cell run. Mean-only exceeding both is a stronger optional quality prediction, not assumed success.

If mean dominance is correct, mean-only exceeds variance-only. Compute factorial interaction I=AUC(both)-AUC(mean-only)-AUC(variance-only)+AUC(neither); a large positive I would instead suggest useful joint coupling.

At fixed weights and buffers all four cells have identical predictions and native running-stat updates. Both reproduces g0-r0022-support_rotated_attached; neither reproduces g0-r0022-support_rotated_blocked. Any deviation beyond host numerical tolerance is implementation evidence, not scientific counterevidence.

All cells have expected total/embedding/dense parameters 32129765/31793216/336549. Evaluation throughput should be similar because it bypasses interventions. Mixed-cell training has extra FP32 correction cost; measure rather than infer efficiency.

Report all task AUC/logloss, auxiliary mean separately, sample/positive/negative counts and existing history bins. Attached prior auxiliary AUCs 0.7788777/0.7876122/0.7571667 are below blocked 0.7880078/0.7967853/0.7756748 and DIN 0.8490697/0.8648975/0.8701823; report any continuing tradeoff. Slice hypotheses are exploratory.
falsifiers: Mean-only fails to retain half of the both-minus-neither gain when that gain is positive, or variance-only consistently exceeds mean-only under subsequent authorized paired seeds: refutes the directional mean-dominance hypothesis for this implementation.
Neither partial candidate improves over the incumbent at justified measured cost: no new quality/efficiency improvement from selective routing, even if a path attribution is informative.
Both-minus-neither fails to reproduce under paired runs: existing support-gradient observation lacks stability; do not elevate its mechanistic status.

Forward/buffer/initialization parity, support-only Jacobian cancellation, finite behavior or causal/masking checks fail: invalidate the implementation before mechanism interpretation; charge failures and halt affected comparisons.
Advantage disappears with paired repetitions, is smaller than uncertainty, or is explained by training cost: retain preliminary or null conclusion. One seed is not significance.
alternative_explanations: The r0022 comparisons are one seed with correlated populations; validation-guided selection across many rounds can overstate the apparent best. No independent repeated support or held-out evidence exists.
Variance coupling, mean coupling or an interaction may be beneficial; optimizer clipping and shared context gradients can mediate outcomes rather than new history information.

Mixed-cell analytic correction may differ numerically from fused BN under BF16 and tiny eps. Native forward bridges are exact, but tensor Jacobians and gradient cancellation need host checks before attributing scores.
Observed auxiliary losses may reflect the primary-versus-auxiliary normalization distribution and shared evaluation buffers. That is a separate unresolved mechanism, not addressed by this factorial.

Reviewed failed/abandoned trajectories: g0-r0006-compressed_task AUC0.6591942 did not beat either frozen source; g0-r0020-feedback_aligned0.6656897 lost to feedback_bridge0.6659300; uniform partition control g0-r0021-target_partition_uniform0.6666620 exceeded the then bridge0.6659300. Later gains cannot be attributed wholesale to joint compression/task queries. Ordered residual trajectories such as g0-r0014-curvature_task0.6656071 provide lineage context, not proof of this new gradient mechanism.

Latest knowledge usage documents consideration of UniMixer and EST, not adoption evidence. This continuation is driven by r0022 outcomes; industry descriptions neither prescribe it nor validate it. Personal knowledge is disabled.
